programme.title: Teri Meri Doriyaann
programme.desc: The fate of the three Brar cousins Angad, Garry and Veer are linked with the three Monga sisters Sahiba, Seerat and Keerat. Sahiba is the hardworking and independent second daughter of the Monga family. She is an artist and earns money for her family by selling her art. Seerat, the eldest Monga sister, is pampered by her mother, Santosh, for her beauty. Santosh dreams of getting Seerat married to a rich man. As fate would have it, Angad falls in love with Seerat. However, Seerat is manipulated by Garry and his fake love. On Seerat and Angad's wedding day, Seerat runs away with Garry.

programme.title: Sinema Pagi: Dari Mata Turun ke Hati

programme.title: Saranjana

programme.title: Royal Tramp 2
programme.desc: Wei the jester, turned undercover spy, turned high ranking official in the Chinese imperial court, tries his best to deal with warring factions and deadly martial artists all vying for power.

programme.title: Destiny's Champion
programme.desc: Brilliant director Sun Chung and the majestic Ti Lung reunite for a thriller about an aging fighter who relives his violent past mistakes through a streetwise kid.

programme.title: Get In The Dark
programme.desc: Miss Qiao had died in vain and her butler paid a paper craftsman to make a paper doll. Miss Qiao's spirit is revived to take revenge and a series of horrible events begins to happen.

programme.title: The Mask Of Shura Of Fire Cloud
programme.desc: The Black Feather clan infiltrated the territory of Master Fire Cloud and stole The Mask of Shura, thus releasing an evil spirit that was a baby. Master Fire Cloud adopted the baby to prevent him from becoming evil.

programme.title: Fight Back To School 2
programme.desc: Sing quits the force after getting demoted to traffic duties, while his partner is assigned a mission involving foreign terrorists threatening to bomb a school in Hong Kong, so Sing decides to help by going undercover at the same school.

programme.title: The Stormriders
programme.desc: An evil warlord takes in 2 students (Wind And Cloud) in an effort to become invincible so he can take over the world.

programme.title: Out Of The Dark
programme.desc: An old lady died after falling off a building and her ghost appears to haunt the place. Freaked out by the haunting, the security guards invite ghostbuster Leo and his assistant to help.

programme.title: Mr. Virgin
programme.desc: When a young man ignores a feng shui master's warning and decides to marry before turning 30, a series of mishaps begins to curse his life.

programme.title: A Man Called Hero
programme.desc: Hero Wah goes to study under Master Pride. When he returns to his parents, he learns that they have been murdered by a band of evil Westerners. After impregnating his wife Jade, he ventures to New York in search of his parents' killers.

programme.title: Green Wood Robbery
programme.desc: Set in the early years of the Republic of China, the wealthy Kang family is brutally murdered, and their young daughter-the sole witness-mysteriously disappears.

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its “Cop Shop Babes” as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat – can they resolve the case?

programme.title: The Viral Factor
programme.desc: Agent Jon contemplates leaving the force until he learns his brother is working as a mercenary for a former colleague who betrayed their team.

programme.title: Confession Of Pain
programme.desc: A detective helps a friend investigate the mysterious death of his father-in-law.

programme.title: Whisper Of Silent Body
programme.desc: Forensic pathologist Qin works with his assistant and the police captain to resolve the backlog of cases.

programme.title: Unbeatable
programme.desc: Fai, once a world champion in boxing, escapes to Macau from the loan sharks and unexpectedly encounters Qi, a young chap who is determined to win a boxing match.

programme.title: Impermanence
programme.desc: A series of strange events is happening in a peaceful village, including a corpse that is resurrected from its grave and ran away. As the villagers investigate, a villain dies and the village head also goes missing.

programme.title: The Flying Mr. B
programme.desc: The Flying Mr. B

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: The story revolves around a dutiful yet indifferent fireman, who can march into disaster and risk his lives by saving others, yet would he have the equivalent courage to tackle his personal issues?

programme.title: Kowloon Walled City
programme.desc: Neng was a street fighter who decides to life in Hong Kong's Kowloon Walled City. He is implicated in the fights and conspiracies. When his friend is hunted down by the triad, Neng must save his friend.

programme.title: How To Choose A Royal Bride
programme.desc: The young emperor Kangxi is attempting to select a bride. His mother has arranged for young available women to visit him so that he may choose.

programme.title: Challenge Of The Gamesters
programme.desc: Wong Jing created the gambling film genre almost singlehandedly, and in one of his earliest blockbusters, Shih Hsien leads a stellar cast in a tale of spies, tycoons and beautiful babes.

programme.title: Final Justice
programme.desc: A cop relies on a young car thief to take down four gangsters, who plan to rob a rich merchant for a large amount of money.

programme.title: Doubles Cause Troubles
programme.desc: Two squabbling cousins find themselves in more trouble than they can imagine after their tenant ends up dead. The gangsters and the police are both after them, and they have no idea what they have done wrong!

programme.title: Legend Of The Fist: Chen Zhen
programme.desc: The year is 1917 and Chen Zhen, believed to be dead, returns to Shanghai under a false name. He joins a mob boss for info on the Japanese incl. a long kill list and at night fights the Japanese masked.

programme.title: Mid-Night Two
programme.desc: The film tells the story of a group of people in order to search for treasure, traveled thousands of miles to the ancient legend of the ghost mountain, for thousands of years whoever have entered the ghost mountain all disappeared, it is said that the mountain buried a female body never decomposed, the Yin fire didn't extinguished in thousand of years, every 2:30 in the morning the Yin fire is the heaviest, all the ghosts would return.

programme.title: Mahjong Heroes
programme.desc: A hero helps a young student deflect a cunning and malicious gambling tycoon who is out to take over the student’s family business over a game of mahjong.

programme.title: Lost Memories
programme.desc: A failed assassination attempt in Harbin, China in 1909 changes the course of history. Now two JBI agents must find the connections between it and an ancient Korean artifact.

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh
programme.desc: Security guard Lee Go is assigned to keep guard at a house while the owner is away. However, a series of hilarious misunderstandings occur.

programme.title: Shark Busters
programme.desc: During the financial crisis, a vast majority of Hong Kong people experience difficulties in repaying debts. During this time, loan sharks use ruthless ways to force debtors to repay their loans and it is up to Officer Lee and his underground team to hunt down the head of this illegal organization.

programme.title: Initial D
programme.desc: For five years, 18-year-old Takumi delivers tofu in his fathers near-obsolete Toyota AE86 every morning and because of that, he has become a good racer and also unwillingly perfected the art of drifting.

programme.title: Royal Tramp
programme.desc: A jester is accidentally recruited by a cult leader to spy on a young and inexperienced Chinese emperor. Things don't go according to plan, and he ends up working for multiple opposing sides while trying to survive the madness.

programme.title: Iceman
programme.desc: An imperial guard and his three traitorous childhood friends ordered to hunt him down get accidentally buried and kept frozen in time. 400 years later passes and they are defrosted continuing the battle they left behind.

programme.title: Gorgeous
programme.desc: A romantic girl travels to Hong Kong in search of certain love but instead meets a kind-hearted professional fighter for whom she begins to fall instead.

programme.title: Hong Kong, Hong Kong
programme.desc: A story of the illegal immigrant experience of people from the mainland of China who have made it to Hong Kong for a better life.

programme.title: The Magnificent Scoundrels
programme.desc: Valentino is a mediocre con artist who crosses paths with Kwan, a fellow con artist. Together, they impersonate various people and create numerous schemes to make money. Meanwhile, gangsters are making a scheme of their own.

programme.title: Fight Back To School 3

programme.title: Iceman: The Time Traveler
programme.desc: The imperial guard and his three traitorous childhood friends ordered to hunt him down get accidentally buried and kept frozen in time. 400 years later pass and they are defrosted continuing the battle they left behind.

Setiap Episode Menampilkan Berbagai Upaya Tom Untuk Menangkap Jerry, Yang Selalu Berakhir Dengan Kegagalan Akibat Kecerdikan Jerry Dan Situasi-Situasi Tak Terduga.

programme.title: Papa Pipi
programme.desc: Papa Pipi Adalah Sebuah Acara Animasi Kekeluargaan Yang Mengisahkan Tentang Papa Zola Dan Anak Perempuannya, Pipi Zola. Bersama-Sama Mereka Menjalani Petualangan Cilik Yang Terkadang Menjadi Lebih Menantang Dalam Kehidupan Mereka.

programme.title: Boboiboy Galaxy Sori The Movie
programme.desc: Boboiboy Galaxy Sori Merupakan Sekuel Lanjutan Dari Boboiboy The Movie 2, Dimana Setelah Boboiboy Berhasil Mengalahkan Retak'Ka, Penguasa Elemen Yang Kejam. Boboiboy Dan Teman-Temannya Pulang Ke Bumi Untuk Menunggu Tugas Selanjutnya. Tanpa Diduga, Seorang Musuh Lama Muncul Kembali Dengan Rencana Jahat Yang Baru. Boboiboy Harus Mempelajari Kekuatan Elemen Tahap Ketiga Di Planet Rimbara, Bekas Jajahan King Balakung, Pemilik Asli Kuasa Elemental Balak Yang Tewas Ditangan Retak'Ka.

programme.title: Metal Cardbot
programme.desc: Dahulu Kala, Terdapat Sebuah Planet Bernama Machina Dimana Metal Cardbots Tinggal. Suatu Ketika, Planet Ini Tiba-Tiba Meledak Dan Memaksa Semua Penghuninya Untuk Hidup Di Bumi. Agar Tidak Menarik Perhatian Makhluk Bumi, Cardbots Menyamar Sebagai Kendaraan Sehari-Hari. Hingga Suatu Hari, Seorang Anak Sekolah Dasar Yang Bernama Jun Secara Tidak Sengaja Menemukan Metal Breath, Dengan Metal Breath Tersebut Dia Bisa Menangkap Dan Menyalakan Cardbots Dengan Kemampuan Yang Berbeda.

programme.title: Boba (Bombastis Banget)
programme.desc: Boba (Bombastis Banget) Merupakan Program Yang Berisi Informasi Ringan Yang Menyajikan Video-Video Bombastis Yang Viral, Lucu, Dan Unik Dari Sosial Media. Bisa Berupa Video Kejadian Yang Tidak Biasa Ataupun Video Yang Sedang Viral. Video-Video Tersebut Akan Dikomentari Dengan Menggunakan Vo (Voice Over) Dan Dikemas Dengan Editing Yang Kekinian.

programme.title: Check In (Check Informasi)
programme.desc: Program Yang Menyajikan Fakta-Fakta Unik Tentang Fenomena Serta Isu Terkini Yang Terjadi Di Dunia Melalui Video-Video Yang Bersumber Dari Media Sosial Dan Dipaparkan Oleh Voice Over (Vo) Yang Unik. Check In Juga Akan Mengajak Interaksi Dengan Masyarakat Melalui Voxpop Tentang Tema Yang Dibahas.

programme.title: Obral (Obrolan Viral)
programme.desc: Obral (Obrolan Viral) Merupakan Program Informasi Yang Dipandu Oleh Dua Host Untuk Menyajikan Berita Terkini, Video Viral Dan Membahas Hal-Hal Unik Yang Dibicarakan Publik Secara Santai Dan Unik Dengan Format Semi Podcast Ala Radio Show.
